cases.sentence: Затем мы повернули назад и отправились в ___ по дороге к Красному морю
cases.translation: Then we turned back and departed into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (into) with motion requires the accusative case.

cases.translation: For a long time we circled around Mount Seir
cases.explain: The preposition 'вокруг' (around) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Не побуждайте их к ___, потому что я не дам вам ни пяди их земли
cases.translation: Do not provoke them to war, because I will not give you any of their land
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (to) governs the dative case here with sense of inviting or inciting.

cases.sentence: Вы должны заплатить им серебром за ___, которую будете есть
cases.translation: You must pay them in silver for the food which you will eat
cases.explain: The preposition 'за' (for) with money/payment governs the accusative case.

cases.translation: We turned from the way of the Arabah valley
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они истребили хореев и поселились на их ___ точно так же, как сделал Израиль
cases.translation: They destroyed the Horites and settled in their place, just as Israel did
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on/at) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Смотри, я отдал в твои руки Амарея Сигона, царя ___, и его страну
cases.translation: Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land
cases.explain: In appositive position, the name after a title takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: От Араэра на берегу реки Арнона и от города Штавдолини до самого Галаада не было ___, который бы оказался неприступным для нас
cases.translation: From Aroer on the bank of the river Arnon and from the city until Gilead there was not a city which would be inaccessible to us
cases.explain: The negation 'не было' (there was not) takes the genitive case for the negated object.

reading.ru: Затем мы повернули назад и отправились в пустыню по дороге к Красному морю, как указал мне Господь.
reading.question: What was God's command regarding the direction of travel after Kadesh Barnea?
options: Go directly to the promised land
Return and travel by the way of the Red Sea
reading.correct: Return and travel by the way of the Red Sea
reading.explain: The text states 'мы повернули назад и отправились в пустыню по дороге к Красному морю' (we turned back and departed into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea).

reading.ru: Дай народу такое повеление: Сейчас вы будете проходить через землю ваших братьев, потомков Исава, которые живут в Сеире.
reading.question: Who were the Israelites about to encounter on their journey?
options: The descendants of Esau dwelling in Seir
reading.correct: The descendants of Esau dwelling in Seir
reading.explain: God commanded the people to pass through 'землю ваших братьев, потомков Исава, которые живут в Сеире' (the land of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir).

reading.ru: Они испугаются вас, но будьте очень осторожны. Не побуждайте их к войне, потому что я не дам вам ни пяди их земли.
reading.question: What was Israel's relationship to Esau's descendants supposed to be?
options: Avoid provoking them to war and not seize their land
reading.correct: Avoid provoking them to war and not seize their land
reading.explain: God instructed them not to provoke war and said 'я не дам вам ни пяди их земли' (I will not give you even one foot's width of their land).

reading.ru: Вы должны заплатить им серебром за пищу, которую будете есть, и за воду, которую будете пить.
reading.question: How should the Israelites relate to the Edomites economically?
options: Take their food and water freely
Pay them in silver for food and water
reading.correct: Pay them in silver for food and water
reading.explain: God commanded 'Вы должны заплатить им серебром за пищу и за воду' (You must pay them in silver for food and for water).

reading.ru: Но Сигон, царь Хешбона, не позволил нам пройти, ведь Господь, ваш Бог, сделал его дух упрямым, а сердце упорным, чтобы отдать его ваши руки.
reading.question: Why would Sihon king of Heshbon not allow the Israelites to pass through?
options: Because he feared their military might
Because God hardened his spirit and heart to deliver him into their hands
Because he wanted to protect his allies
Because of an old dispute with Moses
reading.correct: Because God hardened his spirit and heart to deliver him into their hands
reading.explain: The text explains 'Господь, ваш Бог, сделал его дух упрямым, а сердце упорным, чтобы отдать его ваши руки' (God made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate to deliver him into your hands).

reading.ru: Мы взяли все его города и полностью истребили их. Мужчин, женщин и детей мы не оставили в живых никого.
reading.question: What was the outcome of Israel's victory over Sihon?
options: They captured some of his cities
They utterly destroyed all his cities and left no survivors
They took control without destroying the population
reading.correct: They utterly destroyed all his cities and left no survivors
reading.explain: The text states 'Мы взяли все его города и полностью истребили их' and 'Мужчин, женщин и детей мы не оставили в живых никого' (We took all his cities and utterly destroyed them, leaving no one alive).
